newsitem.title: UK: Drought seen continuing in Europe grain areas.
newsitem.headline: Drought seen continuing in Europe grain areas.

text.p: The dry weather, which has forced prices up across European grains markets is set to continue this week, forecasters said.

On a nervous French market new crop moved clearly above prices for the old harvest for the first time this year on Monday, reflecting new warnings of potential drought damage, while LIFFE futures continued to soar.
Western Europe will be getting very little rain during the coming week, according to Britain's Meteorological Office.
In Britain, during the rest of this week, there maybe the odd shower in the far north-east, but none is likely over southern areas, a spokesman told Reuters.
And there will be little rain in the rest of western Europe. "There may be showers in the north of Spain," he said.
Some rain is possible in south eastern Europe, including parts of Italy and the former Yugoslavia, during the next couple of days, he said.
And towards the end of the week, there may be some rain in Scandinavia, he said.
